data.title: Zohran Mamdani Says 'It's Greed' If Jeff Bezos Adds $5 to Your Order As Amazon Warns NYC Delivery Legislation Could Raise Prices
data.description: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani accused Amazon of greed after the company told customers a City Council bill could raise delivery costs.

data.title: John Paulson’s Hedge Fund Opens New Bet On Calvin Klein Owner PVH With $46 Million Stake, Dumps Alphabet and Adds to Madrigal
data.description: John Paulson adds a $46 million PVH stake, boosts Madrigal to 1.49 million shares and exits Alphabet in Q3.

data.title: Trump Wants China and Russia to Limit Nuclear Weapons But Admits It Will Be 'Very Hard' to Achieve, As 3 Nations Vow Such A War 'Must Never Be Fought': Report
data.description: Trump said nuclear arms limits remain difficult to negotiate after China talks with Xi and Putin, but pledged to keep pursuing dialogue.

data.title: Anthony Scaramucci Hints at 2028 Presidential Bid, Says ‘I Don’t Really Fit Into Either Party’ as He Weighs Republican Party’s Future
data.description: Scaramucci leaves open a 2028 presidential run, citing family security concerns and uncertainty over the Republican Party’s direction.

data.title: Gary Black Warns SpaceX-Tesla Merger Could Wipe Out 24% Premium in Weeks: 'Massive Dilution' Could Crush Shares
data.description: Gary Black warns a SpaceX-Tesla stock merger deal could cause dilution and sharply drag Tesla shares lower.
